5: RUN apk --no-cache upgrade && ! keytool -list -cacerts -storepass changeit | grep -qiE 'emsign.*ecc.*g3'
6: RUN addgroup -S -g 10111 spinnaker

8: COPY echo-web/build/install/echo /opt/echo
9: RUN mkdir -p /opt/echo/plugins && chown -R spinnaker:nogroup /opt/echo/plugins

12: CMD ["/opt/echo/bin/echo"]
